day_local: Ullumi nalliutiqarniaqtuq Saint Teresa of Jesus, Virgin ammalu Doctor of the Church
greeting: Ataniup aqqutiani, Ataataup, Irniup, ammalu Anirniup Salumajup atiagut. Ataniq inuusiup qaumanialu ilissinniittili.
penitential:
Ataniq, ungasiktumik asanninirmik ajurtaugatta, unguvautigitsi.
Kristus, qaujimajavut asanniningit, unguvautigitsi.
Ataniq, uummativut salumajunik tatatigitsi, unguvautigitsi.
homily:
Pitaqarpugut inuusiup iluani, iksivautami, ajjiuqattatut iksivautami, inuit qanigijavut. Takugitsi, taanna iksivautaq, taanna inuusiq. Benjamin, taanna 'Banquet of Heaven'-mi, standing beside Saint Carlo Acutis. Two brilliant, modern boys who loved technology, who loved the world, but who loved God more. They are not dead; they are more alive than we are. They are soaring in the light of the Father, free from all weight, breathing the pure air of heaven. Ben's legacy continues to flow on earth, like the clean, life-sustaining water from the 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' well dedicated in his name in Cà Mau, Vietnam. His middle name, Đại Dương—Great Ocean—remains a sign of God's limitless mercy flowing to those in need. Alan, Thao, ammalu Ryan. Ilissiklu uqumaittumik atuqtut. Qaujimajavut uqumaittuq, qaujimajavut silataani inuusiq. Kisiani, uqaqtuq Gospel-mi, 'Father, hallowed be your name.'

Maanna, qanuritlutik inuit? Ilissik uqumaittumik atuqtut, kisiani Ataniq qaninganiittuq. Qaujimajavut Benjamin-up middle name-nga, Đại Dương, Great Ocean. Taanna ocean-tut, Ataniup asannininga aniguqtilaaqtuq. Ryan, my dear younger brother, Ben's best friend. You stood beside Ben in front of the cockpit display at the museum; you sat beside him on the bench at the laundromat; you stood beside him outside Phở 54 in your scout uniforms. Ryan, Ben loved you with all his heart. You were his partner in adventure, his brother, his daily companion. When you miss him, when the house feels too quiet, remember that Ben's mind and heart were deeply bonded to yours. You carry Ben's memory inside you. Live your life fully, Ryan! Study hard, play, laugh, explore tech or aviation or whatever brings you joy, knowing that your big brother Ben is cheering you on from heaven's best vantage point. Benjamin was a boy of extraordinary intellect and boundless curiosity. A true 'photocopy' of his father in both looks and ambition, he possessed a natural gift for logic and mathematics. To all aunts, uncles, grandparents, cousins, and friends who loved Benjamin: Ben's life illuminated what it means to be truly wise. He was brilliant in math and computer logic, yet he was humble, respectful, and sweet-natured. He showed us that real intelligence is never loud or boastful; real intelligence is gentle, generous, and full of love. Benjamin’s life was a gift, a reflection of the Light that came into the world through Mary. He was a boy who looked at the world with wonder, a boy who built games and dreamed of 'con chim airlines', a boy who offered his piggy bank to help his uncle. These are not just memories; they are the fruits of a life lived in the grace of God. To everyone tuning in from afar—especially families who are carrying heavy crosses, parents who grieve, and children who are suffering in hospitals or homes: You are seen by God. The Gospel reminds us today that Jesus' authority is not a heavy hand that crushes us, but a loving hand that heals, sets free, and restores. The Lord is just in all His ways, gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and full of great kindness. He lifts up all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down. What can we carry out the door today? When your heart feels heavy, when the morning light comes in and you feel the empty chair, do not look only at the silence. Look up at the sky, just like Ben loved to watch airplanes soar, and remember that God's peace is real, God's covenant is forever, and Benjamin Vo is safe in the Father's eternal embrace. Let us pray: 'Lord Jesus Christ, You spoke with authority in the synagogue and brought peace to the hearts of all. Grant us the mind of Christ, that we may see beyond earthly tears into the eternal light of Your Kingdom. Comfort Alan, Thao, and Ryan with Your deep peace. Hold Benjamin Đại Dương Vo close in Your heavenly joy until we all meet again at Your eternal Banquet. Amen.'
spiritual_communion: Ataniq, niriunnirivagit, uummatinniipputit. Asannirivagit, asanninirnirnik. Uummatinniipputit, uummatinniipputit. Amen.
closing: Ataniq, inuusiup qaumanialu ilissinniittili. Ataniq, asanninirnirnik asanninirnirnik asanninirnirnik. Amen.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo-mut ammalu tamainnut inuujunnaqtunut, Ataniup qaumaniani inuulirniarput.
Tamainnut uqumaittumik atuqtunut, Ataniq qanigilluni ikajuqtuiniarput.

readings.label: Ephesians 1:1-10
readings.text: Paul, Aposteli Kristus Jesus-up Ataniup piumajangagut, ilagiiktunut Ephesus-miittunut ammalu Kristus Jesus-mi uqautjijinut: asanninirnik ammalu inuusiup qaumanianik Ataniup Ataatavut ammalu Ataniq Jesus Kristus-mit. Quviasuktuuti Ataniq ammalu Ataataup Ataniup Jesus Kristus-up, piumajangagut Kristus-mi tamainnut inuusiup qaumanianik qilakmi, kisiani niruaqtaujugut, suli silaup sanajaujunniqtillugu, salumajunik ammalu kikkutuinnarnik Ataniup sivuningani. Asanninirmik, niruaqtaujugut irniulluta Kristus Jesus-kut, Ataniup piumajangagut, quviasuktutik asanninirmik. Kristus-mi, annaumajaujugut auniqputigut, ajurniqputigut, asanninirmik. Qaujimajaujuq Ataniup piumajangagut, tamainnut Kristus-mi, tamainnut qilakmi ammalu nunami.

readings.label: Psalm 98:1, 2-3ab, 3cd-4, 5-6
readings.text: R. Ataniup annaumajangit qaujimajauvut. Ataniq aturitsi nutaamik atuutilaurtumik, asanninirmik; Ataniup saumianik annaumajangit. R. Ataniup annaumajangit qaujimajauvut. Ataniup annaumajangit qaujimajauvut: inuit tamainnut takujauvut. Ataniup asanninirnik ammalu uqausirnik qaujimajauvut Israel-mut. R. Ataniup annaumajangit qaujimajauvut. Nunap tamainnut takujauvut Ataniup annaumajangit. Aturitsi Ataniup, tamainnut nunat; aturitsi quviasuktutik. R. Ataniup annaumajangit qaujimajauvut. Aturitsi Ataniup, tusaajauvut, aturitsi quviasuktutik Ataniup.

readings.label: Luke 11:47-54
readings.text: Ataniq uqautjijaujuq: 'Woe ilissinni, sanajaujuq prophet-nut inuit tuquqtaujut. Ilissik qaujimajaujut, qaujimajaujut inuit tuquqtaujut. Ataniup uqautjijaujuq, 'Prophet-t ammalu Aposteli-t aullartiniarput; ilaanni tuquqtaujut ammalu qiniqtaujut.' Innit inuit tuquqtaujut, Abel-mit Zechariah-mut. Woe ilissinni, qaujimajaujut inuit! Ilissik qaujimajaujut inuit. Jesus aullartilluni, scribes ammalu Pharisees qiniqtaujut Jesus-mut, qiniqtaujut qaujimajaujut.

day: Memorial of Saint Teresa of Jesus, Virgin and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
